text.en:
The Run After Tax Evaders (RATE) Program shall be institutionalized into a
regular division in the BIR's Enforcement Service of the Bureau of Internal Revenue

There is hereby created a Revenue Enforcement Committee to be headed by
the Deputy Commissioner for Legal, Inspection and Enforcement Group;

The Large Taxpayers is hereby placed under the Office of the Deputy
Commissioner for Audit and Fraud Investigation. RDO Cesar Lim is hereby designated
to head the Large Taxpayers Service, subject to the rules of the Commission on Elections.

RATE and tax fraud cases shall be given priority in tax investigations in the
Large Taxpayers' Service and the district offices;
Each RDO is hereby required to file one RATE case per month;

BIR Executive Order (EO) No. 175 of President Joseph Estrada is hereby
amended by reverting it to the previous EO No. 430 which would effectively promote
industry audit and benchmarking methods in the national and special investigations of the

The Inspection Group is hereby deputized to proceed administratively against
BIR officials and employees with cases in the Revenue Integrity Protection Services
RIPS (RIPS, alongside the criminal Ombudsman cases of the Department of Finance.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 44 day of April, in the Year of Our Lord Two
Thousand and Seven.
This th. lungs
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
